FAQ

Questions, answered.

Anything else? Call, text, or send us a message on Facebook.

What areas do you serve?

Redlands and nearby cities throughout the Inland Empire. Not sure if we cover you? Just ask.

How much does it cost?

It depends on the job and the size of your home or space. Estimates are always free, and fall packages start at $149.

Can I book more than one service?

Yes. Many customers pair window cleaning with home cleaning or pressure washing in one visit.

Do you clean businesses too?

Yes. We clean homes as well as commercial spaces like offices, hallways, and restrooms.

Why should I get my dryer lint removed?

Lint buildup makes your dryer work harder and is a common cause of house fires. A cleaning helps it run safer and more efficiently.
